scope: Historical snapshot: 164 population-ledger values (126 enrollment, 38 housing); 126 independently read from original IPEDS ZIP total-level cells; 33 retained housing values compared with visually inspected State Auditor tables; 5 original expansion observations checked against saved source PDFs/HTML and metadata. The subsequent 5 observations are covered by the resident follow-up audits; the current ledger contains 169 observations (126 enrollment, 43 housing).

retained_housing_source.source_definition: Number of enrolled students who lived in campus housing by academic year; actual occupancy, not capacity

adopted_observations.scope_note: Arithmetic sum of 7,108 students in university-provided undergraduate housing and 7,095 in graduate housing, autumn quarter 2024. Actual students, not beds or rounded housing percentages. University housing footprint, including any provided off-campus housing, is not parcel-matched to Clery residential geography or overseas branches. Stanford-authored Facts 2025 recovered from StudyInternational mirror; the original university URL returns HTTP 404 after a site migration. Title, visible page 46 and counts corroborate indexed official version, but identical original bytes cannot be authenticated.

adopted_observations.scope_note: Pittsburgh undergraduates: University Housing 3,158 plus separately listed Fraternity & Sorority Housing 300. These disjoint rows are actual student classifications in the fall census. Current CMU Housing office explicitly states on-campus housing is unavailable to graduate students. ASR definition includes fraternity/sorority houses in residential facilities; the source discusses the on-campus fraternity/sorority quad. University-managed off-campus housing and branch footprints are not independently parcel-matched. Other ASR branches show housing not applicable; this is a qualified institutional housing proxy, not an annual mean. The fall 2024 housing table labels its population as Pittsburgh, but its total equals the university-wide undergraduate enrollment across locations. That scope discrepancy remains unresolved. Fall 2025 housing cells are blank.
adopted_observations.verification: Original saved PDF page visually checked and text rechecked

excluded_texas.decision: Context only. Source says residents, not explicitly student-only residents. Family-housing eligibility does not prove inclusion of dependents, but the unresolved definition fails the student-headcount criterion.

qualifications: Stanford2024 university-authored fact book is publisher-hosted mirror; original URL unavailable. Counts/labels visually verified, but identity with original-site bytes cannot be authenticated.

CMU source labels housing as Pittsburgh undergraduates;2024 housing classification total equals all-location undergraduate enrollment. The source values are retained with that scope qualification, without inventing a correction. Current housing office excludes graduate students, but this is not a retrospective property-by-property census verification.
No adopted institutional housing population is asserted to be parcel-matched to every Clery property or branch. Dated snapshots are not person-time or individual victimization probabilities.
Retained ledger hashes explicitly identify the frozen dataset rather than falsely claiming a raw source-PDF hash; actual original upstream hashes are recorded here and in enrollment provenance.
An actual2025population alone does not create a rate: complete eligible numerator coverage is still required.
applicability: Historical 164-observation snapshot before the Yale and Stanford-2023 follow-up. PASS and all check names apply only to the recorded input hashes, not the current 169-observation ledger.
